value.en: Ferdinand I was elected by the Bulgarian parliament in 1887, proclaimed himself Tsar of the Bulgarians in October 1908, and abdicated in favour of the crown prince on 3 October 1918.

value.zh-Hant: 夏洛特在其姊退位後，於1919年1月14日、23歲時成為盧森堡女大公，在位45年後於1964年3月宣布退位，並於同年11月12日正式退位。
value.en: Charlotte became Grand Duchess of Luxembourg at 23 on 14 January 1919 after her sister's abdication; after 45 years of reign she announced her abdication in March 1964, which took formal effect on 12 November.
